# v1.0.101

 Hotfix - custom-domain orgs with anchored-fallback credentials hit 1722 at callback 🔗 Custom-domain orgs without their own BYOC IdP credentials (e.g. exoscale.layer5.io) ran into meshery-cloud-1722 \state validation failed\ immediately after GitHub redirected back to /oidc/callback/github. The W2 state binding stamped the request host (exoscale.layer5.io), but the callback legitimately lands at the canonical host (cloud.layer5.io) because the fallback chain anchors redirect_uri there. The validator&rsquo;s strict host-binding equality refused the cross-host bounce.
What changed 🔗 OIDCStart now stamps the effective callback host into the state payload, mirroring composeCallbackURL&rsquo;s precedence:
BYOC (cred.CallbackHost empty) -&gt; stamp req.Host Anchored fallback (cred.CallbackHost set) -&gt; stamp cred.CallbackHost So the state&rsquo;s host-binding holds whether the callback lands on the same custom domain or on the canonical Provider Org host. TestOIDCStart_ScenarioA2_CustomEtldFallback now asserts `ValidateState(state, cookie,
